summary: Generates arm geometry and deformation helpers for a character arm, controlled by inverse kinematics linked to a handprint/end-affector object.

key_params.name: capttype
key_params.note: Choose Ellipses for Skeleton SOP workflows or Capture Regions for Capture SOP workflows

key_params.name: rotatehand
key_params.note: Match wrist/hand orientation to the handprint object

key_params.name: autoelbow
key_params.note: Use a more natural default elbow twist

key_params.name: flipelbow
key_params.note: Use the alternate elbow-position IK solution

key_params.name: affector
key_params.note: Handprint/end-affector object controlling the IK target

common_gotchas: This is a specialized legacy character-rig SOP; for modern rigs, prefer explicit capture/deform or imported skeletal data when possible.
Rotate Hand expects the end-affector scale transforms to remain at 1.
The capture type must match the rest of the rig: Ellipses for Skeleton SOP, Capture Regions for Capture SOP.
key_concepts: Arm SOP generates arm geometry and deformation helpers controlled by an IK handprint or end-affector.
The capture type chooses whether the output matches Skeleton SOP ellipse capture or Capture SOP region workflows.
Axis, bone radius, limb lengths, elbow twist, and hand rotation controls shape the generated arm rig.
Joint-circle transform controls are intended for refining deformation around bent shoulder, elbow, and wrist regions.
